title.rendered: Top 20 Excellence Scholarships for Outstanding International Students

excerpt.rendered: Are you a bright and talented international student looking for a scholarship? You can study in the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, France, Switzerland for free! Know more about merit-based scholarships out there for excellent students like you. Read more »

2026 ENS International Selection is open to outstanding international students from around the world. The scholarships are towards a Master’s Degree in Sciences or Arts & Humanities or Sciences offered at École Normale Supérieure in Paris, France. Deadline is 15 December 2026. Course starts September 2027. Read more »
